About

I'm an SRE Engineer on the Cloud Operations team for Check Point's Cloud Network Firewall, keeping FWaaS and WAF services healthy across multiple cloud providers.

My day-to-day is incident response, triage, and building automation that makes recurring failures faster to detect and fix.

Alongside work, I'm studying Computer Science and Economics at Tel Aviv University and I'm a member of the university's AI Club.
